title: Spain Cantabria Crop fields
description: Official field boundaries for the Cantabria region of Spain, sourced from Gobierno de Cantabria's SIGPAC system. Contains 820 field polygons with crop classification and administrative codes, converted to fiboa GeoParquet format in EPSG:4326.
readme:
## README.md
# Field boundaries for Spain Cantabria

Provides 820 official field boundaries from Spain Cantabria.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Gobierno de Cantabria.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Gobierno de Cantabria](https://mapas.cantabria.es/)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** CC-BY-NC-4.0 (a non-free license, for non-commerical usage)
- **Projection:** EPSG:4326

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cb/es_cb.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cb/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cb/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/es-cb/es_cb.pmtiles)
